bottom_line: China bans export of rare earth magnet manufacturing technology, tightening control over the permanent magnet supply chain critical for EVs and wind turbines.
what_changed: China added rare earth separation, smelting, and magnet manufacturing technologies to the prohibited export catalog.
why_it_matters: Permanent magnets using NdFeB are essential for EV motors and wind turbines; technology ban prevents competitors from building independent processing capacity.
main_uncertainty: Enforcement against technology transfer via joint ventures and personnel movement is difficult; existing licensed facilities outside China unaffected.

scenarios.name: Effective bottleneck
scenarios.description: Technology ban delays non-China capacity by 5+ years.
indicators: No new magnet plants announced outside China

scenarios.name: Workaround proliferation
scenarios.description: Alternative technologies or licensed pre-ban facilities fill gap.
indicators: ferrite or alternative motor designs gain adoption
